dedupe_keys.name: italian ports register 351 ports with un locode and coordinates and cargo and passenger traffic in the main ports 2014 2017 ministry of infrastructure and transport

description: Two open datasets from the Italian Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport describe the country's seaports. Contents: a register of 351 ports with an internal id, UN/LOCODE, name, locality, type of administration (national or territorial), flags for ports of national importance by administrative competence and of national economic relevance, special cases, and latitude and longitude for 220 of them; it covers the 58 ports of national importance plus other ports that handle ships of 300 gross tonnage or more and report arrivals and departures to the EU SafeSeaNet system. A companion table gives, per main port and year from 2014 to 2017, cargo by type (containers, liquid bulk, dry bulk, ro-ro and other), goods loaded and unloaded, and passengers embarked and disembarked, with coordinates. Producer: the ministry, from information supplied by the Harbour Master offices (Capitanerie di Porto) and the Port System Authorities. Coverage: Italy's coastal and island ports. Format and access: CSV files with JSON and PDF metadata on the ministry's CKAN catalogue, harvested by dati.gov.it. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Free. Caveats: the register's files date from 2022, a third of ports lack coordinates, the traffic table stops in 2017 and some cells are marked not available. Simulation uses: port nodes and throughput for maritime freight and ferry network models, port disruption and coastal hazard exposure studies, and linking ports to road and rail networks. Related records: the ANAS road graph (data-anas-italy-road-graph) and the ministry's open data portal (data-italy-mit-open-data).
